info.text:
Commission-free Robinhood made $2.63 billion in transaction-based revenue (money from trading) in 2025, per its own results.
Most of it came from routing customer orders to market makers, which pay Robinhood for that flow: payment for order flow on stocks and options, rebates on crypto.
Robinhood's transaction-based revenue: $1.40B (2021), $814M (2022), $785M (2023), $1.65B (2024), $2.63B (2025). Net interest revenue added $1.51B in 2025.
In Dec 2020, Robinhood paid a $65M SEC penalty, without admitting or denying the findings, over misleading customers about order flow payments and best execution; the SEC found worse prices cost customers $34.1M even after commission savings. Robinhood said it concerned historical practices.
Defenders say order flow payments fund $0 commissions and price improvement; critics call them a conflict of interest.
The SEC withdrew its 2022 best-execution and order-competition proposals on June 12, 2025; the EU's PFOF ban fully applies after its transition ended June 30, 2026. Brokers' SEC Rule 606 reports show who pays for order flow.
Sources: Robinhood 10-K filings and Q4/FY2025 results (Feb 10, 2026); SEC press release 2020-321; SEC withdrawal (June 12, 2025); EU MiFIR Art. 39a.
News and education, not financial advice.
